description:
Coffee brewing assistant with timer, bean management, and tasting notes

Brew Guide is an all-in-one coffee brewing assistant app.
Features include brewing timer with multi-stage guidance, coffee bean inventory management,
brewing notes with ratings and flavor profiles, and cloud sync support.
- Long-term stable release; future updates focus on fixes and compatibility.
- Save and restore drafts in the step-by-step coffee bean form.
- Sort coffee bean categories by name and restore pull-to-sync.
- Improve cloud sync, conflict handling, and backups before syncing.
- Fix roaster icon overwrites, roasting inventory updates, and refresh after import.
- Preserve edits when saving a brewing method fails.
